title: New-candidate verification context omitted a Factorio installation lock

reproduction.observed: The immutable C30 context was structurally valid but environment-locks.json contained zero Factorio locks. Every native worker then failed closed before launch with Verification context contains no governed Factorio installation lock.

root_cause.summary: Context creation imported Factorio identities only from an already-complete candidate qualification bundle. A new candidate necessarily has no such bundle, creating a circular dependency between context creation and the first native observation. The CLI and protected context job had no FactorioBin input path.

regression_propositions: new-candidate context creation requires an explicit Factorio binary when no exact governed lock exists
the selected Factorio product version equals the target profile qualification version
ABI 3 stores the complete portable installation binary and official-data identity
the protected workflow materializes the context on the protected self-hosted Windows runner
native workers accept only a Factorio installation matching one exact immutable context lock

closure.proof_required: a new immutable ABI-3 C30 context with exact Factorio 2.1.12 lock, complete C30 local/protected qualification, and a complete fresh C24 v5 calibration under ABI 3
